WPSS No.1716 of 2020
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. P.S. Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. with Mr. 
V.S. Rawat, Brief Holder for the State.
As prayed for, six weeks’ time is 
granted to the State to file counter affidavit.
List thereafter.
No good ground is made out to grant 
interim relief to the petitioner at this stage. 
Interim Relief Application (CLMA No.10980 
of 2020) stands dismissed accordingly.
